Solo proof, 31 October 2026. Historical priority unestablished.

1. A DIFFERENT TARGET, WITH AN EXPLICIT REASON

The uniformly honest stationary MEAN-rate endpoint is subject to the
metastable ceiling in PROOF.txt. This file does not withdraw that result.
Its target is the random entropy produced on the PARTICULAR realised
hidden trajectory, including its stationary system-entropy boundary term:

 Sigma_N=log[dP_{0:N}/dP^R_{0:N}](X_{0:N}).               (P1)

P is stationary all-even hidden Markov dynamics; P^R denotes its stationary
path law reversed in time. In discrete time,

 Sigma_N=sum_{t<N}log[dGamma/dGamma^T](X_t,X_{t+1}).

Its expectation is N e(P), but its value is NOT that expectation. In a
stationary finite CTMC over duration T, its expectation is T sigma; local
detailed balance is needed to interpret it as physical total entropy.
It is not medium heat alone when system-boundary entropy is nonzero.

Sigma can be negative. A confidence LOWER endpoint must retain negative
values, or abstain when it fails to certify positivity. Clamping it to
zero would be false: a one-step weakly driven cycle has negative Sigma
with probability arbitrarily close to one half.

Solo construction and proof, 31 October 2026.

finite CTMC sampled on a known time grid. It supplies a mathematical source
and an exact synthetic sampler. It is not hardware, an acquired biological
record, or a new claim that time-symmetric data can reveal dissipation.
That broad capability is established prior art (Skinner-Dunkel 2021).

States are i modulo 16. Put q_{i,i+1}=10, q_{i,i-1}=1, q_{ii}=-11 and
all other rates zero, in fixed inverse-time units. The chain is finite,
irreducible, reciprocal and stationary at pi_i=1/16. All states are even
under the supplied physical reversal. Observe ONLY the binary half-ring
label: Y=0 on {0,...,7} and Y=1 on {8,...,15}.

The stationary entropy-production rate is exactly

                         sigma=9 log(10) nats/time.       (C1)

This follows by pairing every forward flow 10/16 with its reverse 1/16.
It is the path-irreversibility rate of this CTMC; a physical thermodynamic
interpretation still needs its reservoirs, drive and readout model.

theta Q theta=Q^T. Uniform pi is also invariant under theta. Consequently
the complete stationary OBSERVED continuous-time process is reversal

The hidden chain is nevertheless driven under ordinary all-even reversal.
theta is a label-preserving isomorphism to its reversed model, not a
physical odd-variable reversal that is silently substituted into (C1).

It is not the earlier non-embeddable/periodic control relabelled as a CTMC.

I derived and implemented **confidence bounds on realised hidden-path entropy from one stationary record**, without a supplied mixing time or repeated starts. The assumptions are stationary, all-even hidden Markov dynamics.

The strongest results are:

- **General transfer:** every checked predictive-flow dual now supplies a test calibrated for a dependent record and a path-entropy bound. [Proof](producer-workspace/PREDICTIVE_DUAL_PROOF.txt).
- **Substantial finite recovery:** on the specified four-state source, one 6,000-step trace provably recovers 75–100% of actual path entropy with probability at least 97.5%. The saved synthetic draw recovered **90.0%**, with selection penalties included.
- **Convergent implementation:** a time-uniform algorithm approaches the full path entropy per step on that source family. Its numerical precision increases with the horizon. [Proof and construction](producer-workspace/PATH_ENTROPY_PROOF.txt).
- **Continuous-time transfer:** an actual CTMC model passed the mathematical control, certifying **395.8 nats** from its binary record despite an exactly time-symmetric observed law. Duration, preparation and latent-jump costs are recorded. [CTMC proof](producer-workspace/CTMC_PROOF.txt).

[Exact controls passed](producer-workspace/path_entropy_receipt.json), including reversible nulls and invalid-selection counterexamples. The stationary **mean-rate** impossibility result remains intact.

These are solo proofs and synthetic controls. The generic compiler still needs more samples than simpler statistics on this fixture. Historical novelty and physical validation remain unestablished; entropy-martingale inference has substantial [prior work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.08818).
